displayName: NBD Pro — New client error (CRM browser, per signature)

documentation.content:
The CRM in someone's browser (usually Jo's iPhone) hit an error that has not been reported in the last 7 days.

Source: docs/pro/js/client-error-reporter.js posts to /api/client-error; the clientError function (functions/handlers/monitoring.js) writes ONE ERROR log line with jsonPayload.event="client_error". The labels on this alert are the error's signature (sig), page, view and build.

How 'new' works: this is a log-match condition with label extractors, so every distinct sig gets its own alert timeline. A sig that keeps happening re-notifies at most once a day (notificationRateLimit 86400s) and its alert auto-closes 7 days after it opened; a sig seen after that notifies again. Google caps a log-based policy at 20 notifications/day and 2 new alerts/minute — a flood of distinct sigs is the spike policy's job.

Investigate:
  gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="clienterror" AND jsonPayload.event="client_error" AND jsonPayload.sig="<sig>"' --project nobigdeal-pro --limit 20 --format json
Read errorMessage, stack, view, build, standalone, online. Runbook: documentation/runbooks/CLIENT-ERROR-ALERTS.md.
